_README: Tables exposed to Claude. The 'required' section below covers the 7 tables that the built-in domain tools (find_people, get_person_details, search_groups, get_group_roster, search_events, get_event_attendance, get_schedule, etc.) need to function. Everything else provides FK-resolution context — e.g., adding Genders lets Claude show 'Male' instead of '1' when a query joins through Gender_ID_Table.Gender — and supports the generic query_table fallback. Trim sections you don't use. Keys starting with an underscore are section markers and are ignored by the loader.
_section_required: REQUIRED — built-in domain tools won't work without these.
_section_people_household: Person and household lookups — resolve FKs like Gender_ID, Marital_Status_ID, Household_Position_ID into human-readable values.
_section_participation: Participant engagement, membership, and contact log — useful for member-status queries and pastoral-care follow-up history.
_section_group_context: Group lookups — types, roles, meeting cadence. Needed if you want Claude to interpret group queries beyond raw IDs.
_section_event_context: Event and room lookups — needed for facilities/scheduling queries (which room, what type of event, how many attended).
_section_programs_ministries: Program and ministry lookups — needed if you query by program/ministry or want Claude to label events with their program.
_section_user_admin: User-account and background-check lookups — generally low-risk reference data. Note: dp_Users itself is intentionally NOT here (see README).
